method: Cambridge Undergraduate Study fees pages: /fees-funding/tuition-fees (Home) and /international-students/international-fees-and-costs (international fee groups). Course pages carry no amounts (link to fees pages). International page: served inconsistently across cache-busted fetches (2 of 7 fetches returned an older copy reading "The fees below are for 2026 entry. Fees for 2027 entry will be published here no later than 1 October 2026", with lower 2026 amounts, not recorded); 5 of 7 returned "The fees below are for 2027 entry" with a 2027 table, treated as the current page. Amounts are tuition only; College fees (2027-28, separate PDF) not recorded.
